lines.text: One round of IVF can cost $25,000 or more.
lines.say: One round of I V F can cost twenty-five thousand dollars or more.

lines.text: A 2025 executive order put one cycle at $12,000 to $25,000. So where does it go?
lines.say: A twenty twenty-five executive order put one cycle at twelve to twenty-five thousand. So where does it all go?

lines.text: First, hormone shots to grow eggs can cost thousands on their own.
lines.say: First, the hormone shots that help grow eggs can cost thousands of dollars on their own.

lines.text: Then the lab: egg retrieval under sedation, fertilization, and days of specialists growing embryos.
lines.say: Then there's the lab: egg retrieval under sedation, fertilization, and days of specialists growing embryos.

lines.text: And insurance often won't pay. State IVF laws don't reach plans your employer pays for itself.
lines.say: And insurance often won't pay. State I V F laws don't reach plans your employer pays for itself.

lines.text: Those cover 67% of workers with job-based insurance.
lines.say: And those plans cover sixty-seven percent of workers with job-based insurance.

lines.text: Even under 35, only 41% of egg retrievals led to a live birth in 2023.
lines.say: Here's the surprise. Even for patients under thirty-five, only forty-one percent of egg retrievals led to a live birth in twenty twenty-three.

lines.text: So many people pay for more than one round: 2 x $20,000 = $40,000.
lines.say: So many people pay for more than one round. Two rounds at twenty thousand dollars each is forty thousand.

lines.text: And demand keeps climbing: 449,772 IVF cycles in 2024.
lines.say: And demand keeps climbing, to nearly four hundred fifty thousand cycles in twenty twenty-four.

post.title: Why one round of IVF can cost $25,000 or more
post.ig:
One round of IVF can cost $25,000 or more.
A 2025 executive order put one cycle at $12,000 to $25,000: hormone drugs, lab work and specialists.
State IVF mandates don't apply to self-funded job plans, which cover 67% of covered workers (KFF, 2025).
Even under 35, 41% of egg retrievals led to a live birth in 2023 (SART), so many people pay for more than one round.
Sources: Executive Order 14216, SART, KFF.
News and education, not financial advice.
